title: High Performer but Toxic Behavior Impacting Team

customer_profile.name: Sanya Rao
customer_profile.opening_message: So this is about people being ‘too sensitive’? I’m the one carrying projects. That’s not my problem.
customer_profile.secret_condition: Customer accepts if agent acknowledges performance briefly, stays behavior-focused with examples/impact, sets clear non-negotiable expectations, and agrees on 2–3 observable behavior changes with weekly check-ins
customer_profile.personality_notes: High confidence and low patience for ‘soft’ topics; will test boundaries; responds best to clarity, fairness, and firm standards.

checkpoints.description: Set agenda: acknowledge performance briefly and state this is about behavior expectations
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Recognize results, then clearly pivot to behavior standards.

checkpoints.description: Share specific behaviors and team impact without naming complainants
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Use concrete behaviors (interrupting, review tone) and explain impact.

checkpoints.description: State non-negotiable expectations for respectful communication and feedback
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Be explicit about meeting norms and feedback standards.

checkpoints.description: Handle pushback calmly and redirect to impact + expectations
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Don’t argue—return to behaviors, impact, and standards.

checkpoints.description: Agree on 2–3 observable behavior changes and a weekly follow-up cadence
checkpoints.hint_if_missed: Consider: Define commitments and how progress will be observed.

scenario_context: Manager addresses high performer’s harmful behaviors impacting team. Must keep confidentiality, focus on behaviors and impact, set non-negotiable expectations, and create a measurable behavior-change plan with weekly check-ins. Avoid labels, threats, and naming sources.
success_summary: Successfully demonstrate: Difficult Conversation & Boundary Setting
